exclusions.source_text: The patient has a history of uncontrolled brain metastasis.
The patient has Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status 0 to 1.
estimated creatinine clearance (CrCL) using the Cockcroft- Gault formula ≥30 mL/minute.
Total bilirubin ≤1.5 times upper limit of normal (ULN).
Aspartate aminotransferase (AST) and alanine aminotransferase (ALT) ≤3.0 times ULN, (if liver metastases are present, then ≤5.0 times ULN is allowed).
exclusions.threshold: AST/ALT > 3.0 x ULN (> 5.0 x ULN with liver metastases)

exclusions.source_text: The patient has uncontrolled or significant cardiovascular disease defined as New York Heart Association classification III or IV.
The patient has baseline QTc (using the Fridericia correction calculation) \>470 msec in patients without pacemaker.
Patients positive for human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) can be enrolled only in Part 2 of the trial, but HIV-positive patients must meet the following criteria

The patient has clinical evidence of an active second invasive malignancy with the exception of stable prostate cancer on watchful waiting, in situ cervical cancer, in situ breast carcinoma or localized non-melanoma skin cancers.
Women of childbearing potential (WOCBP) and men with sexual partners who are WOCBP must consent to adhere to contraceptive requirements
